Predicates:
FliesFrom(x, y) ::: x flies from airport y.
FliesTo(x, y) ::: x flies to airport y.
Premises:
FliesTo(susan, LGA) ::: Susan flies to LGA airport.
∀x ∀y (FliesFrom(x, y) → ¬FliesTo(x, y)) ::: The departure and arrival can not be the same airport.
FliesFrom(john, LGA) ::: John flies from LGA airport.
Conclusion:
FliesFrom(susan, LGA) ::: Susan flies from LGA airport.
